text: {"lessons":["A gain relative to my cost basis is not, by itself, a reason to sell; I should weigh each position's prospects and role in the portfolio.","Selling winners has felt satisfying, but I should avoid letting that satisfaction dictate timing or make me hold losing positions just to avoid admitting a mistake.","A few months of account results and selective trades are not enough to judge my decisions; I should use a consistent plan and assess outcomes over time."]}
